errors.text: The generated hypothesis reverses the central ductility result: the target reports that Cr addition raises fracture strain from about 11.6% to 14.0%, whereas the hypothesis predicts reduced fracture strain and states that the Cr-free baseline is more ductile.

The interconnected Laves phase is consequently assigned the wrong net mechanical role. In the target, its reticulated morphology impedes crack propagation and compensates plasticity despite being intrinsically brittle; the generated hypothesis instead treats network connectivity as ultimately ductility-limiting.
The predicted outcome omits the target's quantitative increases of approximately 13.5% in yield strength and 20.6% in fracture strain.
